items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee discusses Ceasar Petrillo only in the context of a union dispute affecting recording sessions and the band's reaction; no personal interaction or direct relationship with Petrillo is described.

ctx.x: Did you say that? DeFranco:…and there was a time, at that time that a Petrillo, Ceasar Petrillo was going to stop all recording because of some union dispute with the record companies. And everybody was running into the studios to record as much as they could until the recording ban took hold.
